data.title: Thai shuttler Kunlavut into men’s singles final at Asian Games
data.description: Thailand’s world No.2 Kunlavut Vitidsarn has reached the men’s singles final at the 20th Asian Games, the first Thai male badminton player to reach the event’s title match.

data.title: Track sensation Puripol eyes more records after 2nd sprint gold
data.description: Thailand's track sensation Puripol Boonson says he can still go faster after completing the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games men's sprint double with another meet record.

data.title: India, Pakistan on Asian Games collision course after cricket washout
data.description: NAGOYA — India and Pakistan stayed on course to meet in the Asian Games cricket final after both men's quarter-finals were abandoned Monday because of rain and a sodden outfield in Nagoya.

data.title: Princess leads Thai dressage charge
data.description: TOKYO: Her Royal Highness Princess Sirivannavari Nariratana Rajakanya led Thailand's dressage team at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 as the riders concluded their dressage competition yesterday, with Nynn Puttisombat finishing sixth in the individual final at JRA Equestrian Park in Tokyo.

data.title: Greece stun Klopp's Germany as Ireland show sorrow for Gaza
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Substitute Dimitrios Kourbelis gave Greece a shock 1-0 Nations League win away to Germany on Sunday as Ireland's players wore black armbands for their match against Israel.

data.title: Puripol's golden double act
data.description: Thailand's sprint sensation Puripol Boonson set the Nagoya track ablaze once more, scorching to men's 200m gold at the 2026 Asian Games in a continental record-equalling 19.88 seconds on Sunday.

data.title: Teerasak fires, Hudson gets his reward
data.description: Thailand opened their Fifa Asean Cup campaign in emphatic fashion, brushing aside Pakistan 4-0 at the Si Jalak Harupat Stadium on Saturday night, followed by confirmation from the Football Association of Thailand (FAT) that it had extended head coach Anthony Hudson's contract to February 2028.

data.title: Ireland beat Israel but no handshakes due to war in Gaza
data.description: DEBRECEN (HUNGARY) - Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in a Nations League clash on Sunday amid an eerie and sombre atmosphere that saw the Irish players wear black armbands over the war in Gaza.

data.title: ONE Championship: Asadula Imangazaliev to defend title in Ortikov grand prix rematch
data.description: Asadula Imangazaliev will put his ONE Championship flyweight Muay Thai world title on the line against Aslamjon Ortikov on November 20, with their immediate rematch also serving as a quarter-final of the promotion’s new grand prix.

data.title: Brew Crew, Phils eye LA Dodgers' shock in October
data.description: The Los Angeles Dodgers, seeking a World Series three-peat, are not invincible. Not in the postseason, anyway.

data.title: Big turn out for Central bid to aid women with cancer
data.description: The heart of Bangkok came alive with colour, smiles and a spirit of giving as runners from across Thailand gathered at the outdoor square at CentralWorld for the 18th Central Group Mini Marathon by Good Goods. The event brought participants together to exercise, connect with fellow runners and support women with cancer.

data.title: Man City's meteoric rise clouded by dark shadow
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Manchester City's fate is yet to be sealed but reports they have been found guilty of widespread financial impropriety cast a new light on a meteoric rise from mid-table mediocrity to Premier League domination since a transformative Abu Dhabi takeover in 2008.

data.title: Thai sprint king Puripol: The fastest man in Asia
data.description: Puripol Boonson tore up the record books and Asia’s sprinting order on Friday night, blazing to 100-metre gold in 9.90 seconds to crown himself the continent’s fastest man in front of a roaring Nagoya crowd.

data.title: Manchester City could face ‘drastic’ sanctions
data.description: LONDON - Former Manchester City chairman David Bernstein says the club could face potentially “drastic” sanctions after reportedly being found guilty on all but one of 115 charges for breaching Premier League financial rules over several years.

data.title: Thailand’s football dream buried beneath late China outburst
data.description: Thailand’s Asian Games football campaign came to a sobering end at Toyota Stadium on Saturday, undone by a clinical second-half burst from China that sealed a 3-0 quarter-final defeat and, with it, an early flight home from Japan.

data.title: Pope Leo keeps mum on his team’s baseball miracle
data.description: VATICAN ⁠CITY - Pope ​Leo’s beloved Chicago White Sox may have ​pulled off a miracle ‌this year, making Major League Baseball’s playoffs for the first time since 2021. But the longtime fan of the South Siders ​won’t reveal ⁠if he called on a little help from on high.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang vs Nong-O revived as flyweight Muay Thai grand prix quarter-final
data.description: Rodtang Jitmuangnon and Nong-O Hama will finally meet on November 13 – almost a year after their flyweight Muay Thai world title fight in Tokyo fell apart, but now with a place in the ONE Championship grand prix semi-finals at stake.

data.title: ONE Championship: Panpayak calls for Lamnamoonlek rematch over disputed punch
data.description: Panpayak Jitmuangnon has called for an immediate rematch with Lamnamoonlek Torfunfarm after alleging that a disputed punch following a referee’s intervention affected the outcome of their ONE Championship kickboxing bout.

data.title: Man City to appeal serious Premier League charges
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of 115 Premier League charges for breaching financial regulations, according to reports on Friday, in a ruling that will send shockwaves through English football.

data.title: Hudson hails his 'best ever' War Elephants
data.description: Thailand begin their quest for Fifa Asean Cup glory in Bandung today, with head coach Anthony Hudson declaring he has never enjoyed working with a squad more as his side prepared to open their campaign against Pakistan.

data.title: EPL delivers another dose of drama and keeps the fans guessing
data.description: Due to the extended international break, there are no Premier League games for a couple of weeks. However, EPL fans can savour last weekend's action, in which the league gave us a reminder of its capacity to provide upsets and entertainment.
